summary: Frontend-only performance-refactor regression completed against the public URL. Production build succeeds and emits one 403.39 kB gzip entry bundle plus separate lazy chunks. Invite/admin auth, boot, install-wizard close, live clock, changing CPU/RAM, central live time card, Nummarius/Recharts, Oracle, Thémis, Agenda, configuration VOIX preset, natural-language market intent, restore, AdminPanel users, and normal chunk loading all passed. Two actionability regressions remain: typed 'range tout' cannot be entered while a module window overlays the command bar, and some holographic-window controls are not reliably clickable.

ui_bugs.issue: Normal click on setup-close was intercepted by the SIRIUS Display social controls, and normal click on profile-logout-btn timed out because the animated profile window never became stable. VOIX and Neural2-F normal clicks passed in this run, but close/logout remain unreliable.

integration_issues.issue: After Nummarius opens, its .prime-screen.holo-win intercepts pointer events over sirius-cmd-input, so a user cannot type 'range tout'. Dispatching the same value after the failed normal click proved the command handler works and created dock pills; 'ouvre la bourse' then restored the window.

action_items: Keep the command bar accessible above open module windows, or add an always-visible command/minimize-all control so 'range tout' can be entered without DOM/voice workarounds.

Remove transform animation from interactive holographic window containers (animate a non-interactive child instead) and correct stacking/hit-testing so setup close and profile logout are normally clickable.
Add a lightweight visible Suspense fallback and a chunk error boundary with retry/reload handling instead of fallback=null.
Re-run typed minimize, setup close, and profile logout after fixes.
critical_code_review_comments: lazyModules.js wraps every lazy import in Suspense fallback=null and has no error boundary; slow chunks render blank and a rejected dynamic import has no local recovery UI, even though normal tested chunks loaded successfully.
App.css applies the infinite holoWinFloat transform directly to every .holo-win; this remains the root of moving-target/stale-hitbox behavior on descendant controls despite pause-on-hover.
App.js is 5,128 lines, far beyond the 700-line review threshold; the module routing/window layering logic should be split into focused hooks/components.

The refactor leaves volume/cpu/ram/now placeholders as undefined in App.js; in particular line 843 overwrites cpuRef/ramRef with undefined. Those refs are currently otherwise unused, but dead placeholders should be removed to avoid future NaN/undefined regressions.

success_rate.frontend: 89% (17/19 executed checks passed; typed minimize required a DOM fallback, and normal setup-close/profile-logout actionability failed)

seed_data_creation: None. Used the existing invite and admin accounts; no business records were created or modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Build entrypoints contain only main JS/CSS; lazy chunks are emitted separately. No ChunkLoadError, failed chunk HTTP response, 'Element type is invalid', pageerror, or visible application error appeared while opening Nummarius, Oracle, Thémis, Agenda, SiriusSetup, and AdminPanel. The only console error was the expected initial anonymous /api/auth/me 401; one ambience request was aborted during navigation. Natural market intent opened Nummarius within 13 seconds. AdminPanel rendered 2 users. Re-test with normal pointer actions only.
rca_of_the_issue: The minimize handler itself is sound: once 'range tout' was submitted it hid Nummarius and created dock pills, and reopening restored it. The failure is reachability: open fixed .prime-screen.holo-win elements cover the HUD command input. Close/logout actionability is caused by animated transforms and overlapping independently layered floating panels; Playwright observed an unstable profile window and SIRIUS Display descendants intercepting the setup-close hit point.
